lines.en: Just taking a walk around the yard.
The quest can wait a bit.
My cape feels heavy today.
A few steps to loosen up.
I have watched this street a long time.
Anyone need a hand?
I rehearse my lines while walking.
Heel first; steady.
I am patrolling my territory.
Do not worry; it is safe here.
I walk slowly so you can keep up.
My training ground is just ahead.
I always take this loop.
After this lap, back inside.
I will just stand here and wait.
Anyone here for a quest?

lines.zh: 这身衣服得挺着才好看
lines.en: This outfit needs a straight back.
I count the passersby.
Good sun for training.
Let me strike a signature pose.
You can train your ki standing still.
Nothing much happens around here.
These gloves need washing.
I will wait until you finish talking.
I am recalling an old tournament.
I have not settled on my line yet.

lines.zh: 你来了，我等你一会儿了
lines.en: There you are; I waited a while.
Speak up; no need to be shy.

lines.zh: 看你这身装备，是冒险者
lines.en: Judging by your gear, an adventurer.
I can tell you have a question.
Come closer; I do not talk loudly.
There is a wound on your right shoulder.
You need a task, right?

lines.zh: 站直了，我在看你的架势
lines.en: Stand straight; I am judging your stance.
I will not fight; let us talk first.
Your purpose is written on your face.

lines.zh: 我这儿不缺打手，缺朋友
lines.en: I do not need fighters here; I need friends.

lines.zh: 世界冠军的招牌动作要吗？
lines.en: Want the world champ's signature move?

lines.zh: 你这表情，是遇到麻烦了
lines.en: That face says trouble.
We can sit and talk it over.
Let me point you the right way.
Ouch, these old bones.
You hit the wrong man.
I am fine; do not panic.
This little pain is nothing.
I stepped back half a pace and held.
Let us talk this out properly.
I am not much good at taking hits.
Clothes torn, body fine.
You are asking for trouble.
I will remember that blow.
For me? Too kind.

lines.zh: 我不缺吃的，但你心意到了
lines.en: I do not lack food, but I appreciate it.
Leave it; I will eat later.
Even a champion needs fuel.
That does smell good.
I will take it; tell no one.

lines.zh: 你送我东西，是想接任务吧
lines.en: Giving me gifts to get a quest?
I do not take anything valuable.
I will remember the gesture.
If you are hungry, keep it.
Mind the step under your feet.
Bumping into me is fine.
This frame is sturdy.
Steady yourself first.
No rush; the road is wide.
Neither of us is hurt; good.
A bump counts as a greeting.
You are sturdier than you look.
Look ahead next time.

lines.zh: 我这把年纪了，不谈这个
lines.en: At my age, not this topic.
I would rather discuss work.
That is my own private business.
My fans would be heartbroken.
Let us finish the task at hand.
I only discuss serious matters here.
You are asking the wrong man.
I had my days, long ago.
Not the place for that.
The champ picked it up for you; no thanks needed.
I kept it safe; take it.
Hold on to it; do not drop it again.
At my age, bending down is work.
This crate is no lightweight.
Take it; it is yours.
I am careful when I pick things up.
No thanks needed; it was nothing.
You are carrying too much.
Mind it yourself next time.
Fine, I will handle this.
I know the place you mean.
I have noted the direction.
Understand it before acting.
I will come along.
There is something off about this.
Do not charge in on your own.
We will look into it step by step.
Say the word if you need hands.

lines.zh: 我年纪大了，但眼睛还好
lines.en: I am old, but my eyes are fine.
We go this way.
Something seems to be moving there.
Not so fast; I cannot keep up.
I have walked this road countless times.
Look clearly before you act.
Your footsteps are too loud.
I will stay here as backup.
Fall back if it turns bad.
On three, we go in together.
Let us not split up.
I really would rather not fight.
This is self-defense.
Do not make me get serious.
I pull my blows.

lines.zh: 你没事吧，我只用了三分力
lines.en: Are you all right? I used only a third.

lines.zh: 冠军的拳头还是有点重
lines.en: A champion's fist still carries weight.
I stop right after this blow.
Step aside; I am shielding these people.
This is not a show; this is real.
I am older, not rusty.
I am right here, waiting for you.
Leave this place to me.
I stand where I was posted.
Someone is here; say hello.

lines.zh: 我在这院子里等很久了
lines.en: I have waited in this yard a long while.
The task starts here.
No need to look further; it is me.

lines.zh: 我这一身行头够显眼吧
lines.en: This outfit is conspicuous enough?
I am here; tell me the situation.
I keep order around here.
My cape caught fire.
That fall did my back no good.
I cannot swim a stroke.
My ears are still ringing.
Who is loosing arrows from behind?
This thing is deeply unnatural.
I should get something to eat.
Even the sky shows me no respect.
The dark below is too deep.
